dedupe_keys.name: an open source gis tool to quantify the visual impact of wind turbines and photovoltaic panels

description: Minelli, Annalisa and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented GRASS extension models visual exposure of wind turbines and solar facilities using terrain and facility geometry. The documented workflow tests synthetic examples and real settings. It supplies a spatial calculation for infrastructure siting and visual-impact assessment, not a physical wind-flow or electricity-generation model. Public open-source availability through GRASS GIS AddOns is established by the source, while exact code-reuse terms and repository identity remain unspecified in the inspected metadata. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
